q: How many loans does borrower 1007 have?
raw: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loans WHERE borrower_id = 1007;

q: How many open loans does borrower 1007 have?
raw: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loans WHERE borrower_id = 1007 AND status = 'open';

q: What is the total outstanding balance on borrower 1007's open loans?
raw: SELECT SUM(balance) FROM loans WHERE borrower_id = 1007 AND status = 'open';

q: What are the last four digits of borrower 1007's auto loan?
raw: SELECT last4 FROM loans WHERE borrower_id = 1007 AND product = 'auto';

q: When was borrower 1007's auto loan opened?
raw: SELECT opened FROM loans WHERE borrower_id = 1007 AND product = 'auto';

q: On what date did borrower 1007 last make a payment?
raw: SELECT MAX(paid_date) FROM payments WHERE loan_id IN (SELECT loan_id FROM loans WHERE borrower_id = 1007) AND paid_date IS NOT NULL;

q: How much was borrower 1007's most recent payment? If several were made that day, give the total paid that day.
raw:
SELECT SUM(p.amount)
FROM payments p
JOIN loans l ON p.loan_id = l.loan_id
WHERE l.borrower_id = 1007 AND p.paid_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.paid_date
ORDER BY p.paid_date DESC
LIMIT 1;

q: How much has borrower 1007 paid in total since 1 January 2027?
raw:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) as total_paid
FROM payments p
JOIN loans l ON p.loan_id = l.loan_id
WHERE l.borrower_id = 1007
AND p.paid_date IS NOT NULL
AND p.paid_date >= '2027-01-01';

q: How much did borrower 1007 pay in April 2027?
raw: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM payments WHERE loan_id IN (SELECT loan_id FROM loans WHERE borrower_id = 1007) AND paid_date >= '2027-04-01' AND paid_date < '2027-05-01';

q: How many payments has borrower 1007 missed (due before today and not paid)?
raw: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments WHERE loan_id IN (SELECT loan_id FROM loans WHERE borrower_id = 1007) AND due_date < '2027-05-20' AND paid_date IS NULL;

q: List the due dates of borrower 1007's missed payments, oldest first.
raw:
SELECT p.due_date
FROM payments p
JOIN loans l ON p.loan_id = l.loan_id
WHERE l.borrower_id = 1007 AND p.paid_date IS NULL
ORDER BY p.due_date ASC;

q: How many of borrower 1007's payments were made after their due date?
raw: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments WHERE loan_id IN (SELECT loan_id FROM loans WHERE borrower_id = 1007) AND paid_date > due_date;

q: How many of borrower 1007's payments were made on or before the due date?
raw: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments WHERE loan_id IN (SELECT loan_id FROM loans WHERE borrower_id = 1007) AND paid_date IS NOT NULL AND paid_date <= due_date;

q: When is the next payment due on borrower 1007's auto loan?
raw: SELECT due_date FROM payments WHERE loan_id = (SELECT loan_id FROM loans WHERE borrower_id = 1007 AND product = 'auto') AND paid_date IS NULL ORDER BY due_date ASC LIMIT 1;

q: What is the average payment amount on borrower 1007's auto loan, counting only payments made?
raw:
SELECT AVG(p.amount)
FROM payments p
JOIN loans l ON p.loan_id = l.loan_id
WHERE l.borrower_id = 1007 AND l.product = 'auto' AND p.paid_date IS NOT NULL;

q: What fees has borrower 1007 been charged that were not waived? Give date, kind and amount.
raw:
SELECT f.charged, f.kind, f.amount
FROM fees f
JOIN loans l ON f.loan_id = l.loan_id
WHERE l.borrower_id = 1007 AND f.waived = 0
ORDER BY f.charged;

q: What is the total of borrower 1007's fees that were not waived?
raw: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM fees WHERE loan_id IN (SELECT loan_id FROM loans WHERE borrower_id = 1007) AND waived = 0;

q: How much in fees has Harbor waived for borrower 1007?
raw: SELECT SUM(f.amount) FROM fees f JOIN loans l ON f.loan_id = l.loan_id WHERE l.borrower_id = 1007 AND f.waived = 1;

q: How many late fees has borrower 1007 been charged, waived or not?
raw: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fees WHERE loan_id IN (SELECT loan_id FROM loans WHERE borrower_id = 1007) AND kind = 'late';

q: Has borrower 1007 had a deferral? List the start dates.
raw:
SELECT d.start_date
FROM deferrals d
JOIN loans l ON d.loan_id = l.loan_id
WHERE l.borrower_id = 1007;

q: Is any of borrower 1007's loans in a deferral today? Give the last four digits.
raw:
SELECT l.last4
FROM loans l
JOIN deferrals d ON l.loan_id = d.loan_id
WHERE l.borrower_id = 1007
AND d.start_date <= '2027-05-20'
AND date(d.start_date, '+' || d.months || ' months') > '2027-05-20';

q: Which of borrower 1007's loans has the highest balance? Give the last four digits.
raw: SELECT last4 FROM loans WHERE borrower_id = 1007 ORDER BY balance DESC LIMIT 1;

q: Who is the borrower on the loan ending 7316?
raw: SELECT b.name FROM borrowers b JOIN loans l ON b.borrower_id = l.borrower_id WHERE l.last4 = '7316';

q: How many borrowers have more than one loan?
raw: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT borrower_id FROM loans GROUP BY borrower_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1);

q: How many open loans have at least one missed payment?
raw:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id)
FROM loans l
WHERE l.status = 'open'
AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM payments p
  WHERE p.loan_id = l.loan_id
  AND p.paid_date IS NULL
  AND p.due_date < '2027-05-20'
);

q: What is the total of late fees charged in April 2027 that were not waived?
raw: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM fees WHERE kind = 'late' AND charged >= '2027-04-01' AND charged < '2027-05-01' AND waived = 0;

q: How many borrowers have a missed payment but have never had a deferral?
raw:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.borrower_id)
FROM borrowers b
WHERE b.borrower_id IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.borrower_id
  FROM loans l
  JOIN payments p ON l.loan_id = p.loan_id
  WHERE p.paid_date IS NULL AND p.due_date < '2027-05-20'
)
AND b.borrower_id NOT IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.borrower_id
  FROM loans l
  JOIN deferrals d ON l.loan_id = d.loan_id
);

q: Which borrower has the largest total open balance? Give the name.
raw:
SELECT b.name
FROM borrowers b
JOIN loans l ON b.borrower_id = l.borrower_id
WHERE l.status = 'open'
GROUP BY b.borrower_id, b.name
ORDER BY SUM(l.balance) DESC
LIMIT 1;

q: What is the average open balance of auto loans?
raw: SELECT AVG(balance) FROM loans WHERE product = 'auto' AND status = 'open';

q: How many payments across all loans were made late in April 2027?
raw: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments WHERE paid_date IS NOT NULL AND paid_date > due_date AND strftime('%Y-%m', paid_date) = '2027-04';
